statement: Fix a cluster patch from Proposition 13.3, cleaned by Lemma 13.4 at the corners of a sufficiently fine parameter mesh. For any common choice of barycentric corner probabilities, there is a slice experiment with primitive data W, odd bin probabilities qW g , conditional in-bin laws UW g , odd marginal laws pW g , and even subprobability rows σv. The odd bin probabilities, individual label masses, and in-bin support sizes obey (14.1). The even rows have the bounds N max x σv(x) ≤ 2hi e−500si , Eσv(x) ≤ K/Mi, where the expectation uses unrestricted primitive data and internal reference sampling. Whenever an even row is nonzero, it is a probability law supported in one cleaned corner support and on common neighbors of every internal odd label. The local tests in (14.3) assert local validity and 118 bound the internal reference probability of σv = 0, conditional on W, by ϵi = e−.001akihi . They hold simultaneously in a slice except with probability exp(−h 1+Ω(1) i ). All estimates are uniform in the corner probabilities, with the deterministic local consultation domains specified below.
